summary: Accomplished Azure Infrastructure Executive with 16+ years of expertise in spearheading enterprise-scale cloud operations, infrastructure governance, and digital transformation for global organizations. Expert in architecting resilient hybrid cloud ecosystems, driving FinOps maturity, and leading cross-functional teams to achieve operational excellence. Strategic leader focused on reliability, security, and stakeholder alignment in complex, high-scale environments.

experience.role: Head of Cloud Operations / Infrastructure Architect
bullets: Spearheaded the migration of 5,000+ legacy workloads to Azure Landing Zones, reducing enterprise data center footprint by 40% and achieving $12M in annual operational savings.
Architected a robust Disaster Recovery framework using Azure Site Recovery for Tier-0 applications, improving Recovery Time Objective (RTO) by 60% and ensuring 99.99% service availability.
Governed enterprise cloud spend by implementing a comprehensive FinOps framework across 200+ subscriptions, resulting in a 25% reduction in cloud waste within the first 12 months.
Standardized infrastructure provisioning across global business units by orchestrating Azure Policy and Blueprints, increasing compliance scores from 65% to 98%.
Directed a cross-functional team of 20+ engineers to modernize legacy perimeter security with Azure Firewall and Entra ID, eliminating three critical security vulnerabilities.
Orchestrated the architectural design and deployment of a hybrid cloud connectivity model using ExpressRoute and VPN Gateway, supporting 10,000+ internal users across 15 global sites.
Optimized enterprise monitoring and observability by implementing Azure Monitor and Log Analytics, reducing mean time to resolution (MTTR) for infrastructure incidents by 35%.
Led the infrastructure modernization program for the core banking platform, transitioning $2M worth of hardware to a resilient, auto-scaling Azure environment.
Improved stakeholder transparency by architecting executive-level reporting dashboards for cloud performance, reliability, and cost-to-serve metrics.
Transformed legacy on-premises server environments for mid-sized enterprises into virtualized private cloud infrastructures, reducing physical hardware costs by 50%.
Spearheaded the lifecycle management of global Exchange and Active Directory environments for 5,000+ users, ensuring 100% identity availability during critical business hours.
Modernized backup and recovery strategies by implementing enterprise-grade storage solutions, reducing backup windows by 4 horas daily.

education: Bachelor of Science in Information Technology
